sophia_cs: Heads-up: Support just escalated Kelp Health (acct KH-204) — renewal at risk. Details below.
liam_support: Customer hit repeated embed latencies + token spikes; they saw 5% higher bill this month. Flagged as priority-1 renewal risk. PM says they might pause.
maya_csm: Thanks — what's the ask? want us to own comms / mitigation?
liam_support: They want immediate onboarding check-in plus a hotfix: reduce embed QPS via rate limits and cache. Engineering suggestions: short-term routing to dedicated instance.
ataru_se: We can spin a dedicated pool for them for 48-72h; need approval from ops and budget owner. Quick config: instance=dedicated-gpu-2, max_burst=150qps, route_policy=priority.
maya_csm: Comms plan draft:
- 1) Call w/ customer on Mon 9am PT
- 2) Temporary dedicated pool + reduce QPS
- 3) Follow-up health dashboard shared
I'll draft email. @sophia_cs want to review tone.
sophia_cs: Yes — keep it empathetic, own the issue. Include measurable targets: latency <200ms 95th, cost delta <=5% after optimizations.
liam_support: Adding logs snippet:
```
error rate spike 2026-03-18T14:22:11Z embed-service: KV cache miss surge
```
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1187 assigned to eng-runtime.
akash_ops: If we approve dedicated pool, I need a Jira ticket + budget tag 'cs-temp-pool'. ETA to provision ~2 hours after ticket.
maya_csm: I'll open a JIRA with description + budget tag. Draft message for MH contact: 'we're prioritizing you; temporary dedicated capacity will be applied; meeting scheduled Mon 9am PT'
sophia_cs: Perfect. After JIRA, @liam_support please send customer the meeting invite and SLAs we'll track. I'll prepare the summary for renewal AE.
liam_support: :thumbsup: will do. Anything else? Thoughts on enabling Optimize suggestions (quantize)?
ataru_se: We can push quantized variant as fallback; small quality delta. I'll include in rollout plan.
maya_csm: Thanks team. I'll paste JIRA link when created.
